mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_package (gym_id, name, price, description, is_active, membership_enabled, membership_duration_months, membership_duration_days, pt_enabled, pt_session_count, locker_enabled, locker_duration_months, locker_duration_days, uniform_enabled, uniform_duration_months, uniform_duration_days) VALUES (#{gymId}, #{pkg.name}, #{pkg.price}, #{pkg.description}, #{pkg.active}, #{pkg.membershipEnabled}, #{pkg.membershipDurationMonths}, #{pkg.membershipDurationDays}, #{pkg.ptEnabled}, #{pkg.ptSessionCount}, #{pkg.lockerEnabled}, #{pkg.lockerDurationMonths}, #{pkg.lockerDurationDays}, #{pkg.uniformEnabled}, #{pkg.uniformDurationMonths}, #{pkg.uniformDurationDays})
mapper.update: UPDATE product_package SET name=#{pkg.name}, price=#{pkg.price}, description=#{pkg.description}, is_active=#{pkg.active}, membership_enabled=#{pkg.membershipEnabled}, membership_duration_months=#{pkg.membershipDurationMonths}, membership_duration_days=#{pkg.membershipDurationDays}, pt_enabled=#{pkg.ptEnabled}, pt_session_count=#{pkg.ptSessionCount}, locker_enabled=#{pkg.lockerEnabled}, locker_duration_months=#{pkg.lockerDurationMonths}, locker_duration_days=#{pkg.lockerDurationDays}, uniform_enabled=#{pkg.uniformEnabled}, uniform_duration_months=#{pkg.uniformDurationMonths}, uniform_duration_days=#{pkg.uniformDurationDays} WHERE id=#{pkg.id} AND gym_id=#{gymId}
